headline: South Africa Central Bank Holds Repo Rate, Signals Potential Hikes
summary: South Africa's central bank kept its key interest rate unchanged on November 19 after a 4-to-3 vote. Officials warned that rising fuel prices are pushing up inflation, keeping the door open for future rate increases.
why: The South African Reserve Bank formulates monetary policy for Africa's most developed economy.

impacts.name: South Africa Repo Rate
impacts.why: The central bank maintained current borrowing costs while issuing hawkish guidance on inflation risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A divided monetary policy committee and warnings of prospective rate hikes weighed on South African financial markets.
